test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

By the time I turn thirty / I would had visited every / continent in the world and have gained / a wealth of knowledge and experience.

options.text: By the time I turn thirty
a wealth of knowledge and experience
continent in the world and have gained

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the verb phrase 'would had' is incorrect.
 
• The correct form should be 'would have' instead of 'would had'.
 
• The correct sentence should be: ***I would have visited every***.

Hence, the correct sentence is** "By the time I turn thirty I would have visited__ every continent in the world and have gained a wealth of knowledge and experience."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When using **modal verbs** like **would, could, should, etc.**, they are always followed by the **base form of the verb 'have'**.
 
• Example: ***She would have gone** to the party if she had known about it.*
